verdict.rationale: LangSmith includes a Playground, LangSmith Engine, and agent deployment, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents LangSmith acting as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence is an official LangSmith MCP server (probe-4), which is the opposite role: it exposes LangSmith to other agents. Agent Auth OAuth access is an adjacent feature, not MCP tool consumption.
